commits.message:
feat: add lint for inefficient Bytes concatenation

Adds the soroban_inefficient_bytes_concat lint that detects Bytes
push_back and append calls inside loops. Every Bytes mutation crosses
the Soroban host boundary, making per-iteration calls expensive.

- New lint: SOROBAN_INEFFICIENT_BYTES_CONCAT (warn)
- Detects push_back and append on soroban_sdk::Bytes in loops
- Suggests accumulating in Vec<u8> and converting via Bytes::from_slice
- Test fixtures cover for/while/loop, good patterns, and #[allow]
- Real SDK fixtures and integration test updated

Closes #51
